name: Crompton Greaves CG-IPM-15 synthetic industrial pump — 1-second multi-domain telemetry — remaining useful life (seconds) (univariate RUL forecasting bundle)
citation: Rajesh T. & Pillai, A. S. (2025). Crompton Greeves Three Phase Pump-Predictive Maintenance Dataset. IEEE DataPort. DOI: 10.21227/1bzr-hq65 (https://doi.org/10.21227/1bzr-hq65). Dataset page: https://ieee-dataport.org/documents/crompton-greeves-three-phase-pump-predictive-maintenance-dataset. Public CSV mirror used by this pipeline: https://github.com/rajesh-amrita/pump_maintenance (MBG12_1sec_data.csv).
license: IEEE DataPort default: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) — attribution required (https://doi.org/10.21227/1bzr-hq65). Also cite the GitHub mirror if redistributing the CSV.
description: Pump remaining useful life. This bundle forecasts `remaining_useful_life` (seconds until first failure_code > 0). Source: IEEE DataPort DOI 10.21227/1bzr-hq65 (Rajesh & Pillai 2025); CSV fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rajesh-amrita/pump_maintenance/main/MBG12_1sec_data.csv. SYNTHETIC 1 Hz series (not field meters): 259200 rows spanning 2024-01-01..2024-01-03 after second expansion. Windows aligned with TempusBench SKAB seconds tasks: context_window=2048, forecast_horizon=64. Sensors used: tri-axial vibration, inlet/outlet pressure, stator/bearing temperature, flow.
preprocessing: 1. download_pump.py: GET GitHub raw MBG12_1sec_data.csv → data/maintenance/pump/raw/.
2. Dataset is SYNTHETIC (GPT-4o + stochastic hybrid generator) emulating Crompton Greaves CG-IPM-15 three-phase centrifugal pump; 26 sensor streams + Failure_Code.
3. transform_pump.py: snake_case columns; map vibration_x/y/z, inlet/outlet_pressure, stator/bearing_temperature, flow_rate, motor_speed, failure_code.
4. Raw Timestamp column is minute-resolution with 60 rows per minute; expand each minute group to unique 1-second UTC stamps (offsets 0..59s) — true 1 Hz grid.
5. Keep native 1-second sampling (no hourly resample). Drop duplicate timestamps; coerce sensors numeric.
6. first_fail = first index with failure_code > 0 (observed first_fail_idx=216000); remaining_useful_life = seconds until that index (clipped ≥0).
7. failure_probability_64s = 1.0 iff RUL ≤ 64 (matches forecast_horizon=64 / SKAB-style seconds windows).
8. Rolling-median window=5 + mean±4σ clip on sensor channels (not failure_code).
9. Write pump_cg_ipm15.parquet (259200 rows, 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z..2024-01-03T23:59:59Z ≈ 3 days @ 1 Hz) then TempusBench CSV (context=2048, horizon=64).
